GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2014-09-22T20:31:14Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Defining field and name for foreignKey in association
Description: Hi, so I am migrating to Sequelize from Geddy/Model while using a Postgres. In Geddy all properties in the code are camelCase and when making queries it translates things to snake_case. 

To keep with our existing codebase I want to continue having properties in the code be camelCase while column names are snake_case. For the property names I created a work around by creating a wrapper around `sequelize.define` to add a field entry to all attributes. 

I have not figured out how to do this for associations. I want to be able to specify `consult.find({where: {userId: 12}})` and have Sequelize know that the column name should be `user_id`. Is it possible to specify both field and name for foreignKey associations? Or what would be an appropriate work around?

Right now I am using the most up-to-date beta (I believe it is 8) and intend on migrating to 2.0.0 when it comes out.
